fieldNotes.location: Confirmed. UNFI Mechanicsville DC at 8258 Richfood Rd, Mechanicsville, VA 23116 (geocoded ROOFTOP to 37.63407,-77.40284, matching the roster coords almost exactly). Legacy Richfood / SuperValu conventional-grocery distribution complex serving the Richmond mid-Atlantic region; the road name 'Richfood Rd' is itself the heritage tell.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE - the main truck entrance off Richfood Rd / the south access road has a guard checkpoint: at z19-z20 a booth structure with a lane canopy/island, queue lanes and a checkpoint apron is visible where the truck road enters the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE - small staffed booth at the entry checkpoint beside the inbound lanes. remoteGs=false accordingly.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - a campus: the main multi-section warehouse plus a separate building cluster to the south (fleet maintenance / fuel island) and additional adjoining structures - 4+ distinct buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE - distinct dock banks on different building faces; trailer drop yards on the west, north and east sides indicate physically separated shipping and receiving clusters typical of a large conventional-grocery DC.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - very large multi-section warehouse with dock banks on multiple faces; estimate ~110 doors total.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - extensive trailer drop yards on three sides of the complex, well over 100 trailers parked in the captured imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - multiple dedicated trailer-storage lots distinct from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: TRUE - paved areas and staged trailers along the access road outside the checkpoint give pre-gate waiting room.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - large paved holding areas inside the gate before the dock faces.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE - wide entry apron with multiple lanes and unused paved width; room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the DC sits on a wooded exurban parcel north of Richmond off a divided highway; broader setting is edge-of-metro/rural rather than dense urban fabric.
fieldNotes.scale: Not clearly confirmed - a weigh platform may exist near the maintenance/fuel cluster but is not unambiguous in imagery; left false and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~70 acres estimated from the perimeter box covering the campus and its trailer yards.
